title: Security Testing Fundamentals
description: Integrate security testing into your development workflow.

data.text:
**Security Testing Fundamentals**

Security testing verifies that your defenses work as intended and catches issues before they reach production.

items: SAST: static analysis of source code
DAST: dynamic testing of running apps
Penetration testing: manual or automated exploitation

data.text: Security testing should happen early and often. Catching a vulnerability in development costs pennies; fixing it in production costs thousands.

data.title: CI/CD Security Pipeline
data.content:
1. Lint and SAST on every PR
2. Dependency scan on merge to main
3. DAST scan on staging deploy
4. Pen-test before major releases

items: SonarQube: code quality and security rules

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Shift left: test early and often
data.takeaway: Security testing is a continuous process, not a one-time gate.
